svg.title: Top view of glove mounting and tendon routing
svg.desc: Back of a right hand. A base plate sits on the back of the hand, held down by a palm strap near the knuckles and tied to a wrist strap by a tail. Cables run from three spools along the back of thumb, index and middle finger through guide rings to fingertip caps.
svg.text: Fingertip cap, cable knotted on top
Cable on the back of the finger
Wrist strap, takes the cable pull
